title: the_group_chat
beats: I got added to a group chat with forty people I didn't know.
No names I recognized. No profile pictures. Just numbers.
I left immediately. Normal reaction, right?
Ten minutes later, I got a friend request. Then another. From every single number in that chat.
I declined them all and started blocking. Five numbers in, my phone buzzed.
A text, from a number I hadn't blocked yet. It said: wrong chat. delete this before tuesday.
Delete what? I'd already left. There was nothing on my phone to delete.
I texted back exactly that. The reply came in four seconds.
Tuesday came. I barely slept. Nothing happened.
Wednesday morning, my sister called me in a panic. Her entire cloud account had been wiped overnight. Photos, messages, backups. Ten years. Gone.
Except one new file, uploaded at 3:04 a.m.
A screenshot of that group chat. With my number highlighted.
The police said it was probably a phishing scam. Probably.
But I still haven't deleted that unknown number from my phone. Because I'm scared of what gets deleted next if I do.
